steps.title: Charge
steps.imageAlt: G Pen Dash+ USB-C charging port

bullets.text: Plug **any USB-C cable** into the charging port on the side.
Give it a full charge before first use. It takes about **1 hour**.

steps.title: Load
steps.imageAlt: Loading the G Pen Dash+ herb chamber

bullets.text: **Fully load** the **titanium chamber** with ground dry herb.
**Pack lightly** with the included pick tool. Do not overpack.

note.text: **~0.3 g capacity.** A proper pack allows airflow. Overpacking restricts draws and reduces vapor quality.

steps.title: Activate
steps.imageAlt: Setting temperature on the G Pen Dash+

bullets.text: **Hold the power button for 4 seconds** to turn on. The display lights up.
Press **Left / Right** to adjust your target temperature.
**Double-click** to start a session. The device vibrates twice when it reaches temperature (~20 seconds).
The session auto-ends when the countdown hits 0:00. The device goes to standby.

press.sub: Hold 4 seconds to turn on · 2 seconds to turn off

steps.title: Draw
steps.imageAlt: Drawing from the G Pen Dash+

bullets.text: Once the device vibrates, wait **30 seconds** for your material to bake, then **draw slowly and steadily** through the mouthpiece.
The spiral ceramic air path cools vapor before it reaches you.
The device powers off automatically after **1 minute** of no activity.

note.text: **After your session:** let the device cool, then remove the mouthpiece and brush out the chamber and mouthpiece filter screen. Regular cleaning keeps flavor and airflow at their best.

steps.title: Clean
steps.imageAlt: Dash+ with its magnetic mouthpiece removed for cleaning

bullets.text: **Power it off** and let it **cool completely** first.
Dip a **cotton swab** in **isopropyl alcohol (ISO)** and squeeze out the excess.
Swab around the **silicone insert**, over the **screen**, and above and **inside the heating chamber**.
For resin buildup, remove the **filter screen** and **ceramic spiral air path** and soak them in ISO.
Wipe them with a **dry swab** and let them **air dry** before putting them back in the mouthpiece.

note.text: **Never soak the device** in alcohol or any liquid.

faq.question: Device won't turn on
faq.answer: Hold the power button for a full 4 seconds. If nothing happens, charge the device. The battery may be depleted. The LED display lights up when it's on.

faq.question: How do I know it's ready to use?
faq.answer: After you double-click to start a session, the device vibrates twice when it reaches your set temperature. Wait about **30 seconds** for your material to heat through, then start drawing. The session countdown shows on the display.

faq.question: Vapor is thin or tastes off
faq.answer: Try a finer grind and make sure the chamber isn't overpacked. Clean the mouthpiece and air path regularly. Residue buildup is the most common cause of reduced vapor and off flavor.

faq.question: What do the error codes mean?
faq.answer: The Dash+ shows a code when something needs attention. **Overheating:** turn it off, wait five minutes, and turn it back on. **E02** (temperature sensor problem) or **E08** (heating coil not connected): contact G Pen support. If the overheating message keeps coming back, contact support too.

faq.question: What does the warranty cover?
faq.answer: The Dash+ comes with a **2-Year Limited Warranty** covering electronics and manufacturing defects. Physical damage is not covered.
